sections.heading: What is trending: “centre de données”
paragraphs: “centre de données” appeared on Google Trends' Trending Now list for FR (snapshot taken 2026-11-06T06:54:07+00:00 UTC). Google reports at least 200 searches for this term — that figure is a lower bound published in the official Trends feed, not an exact count.

sections.heading: What's behind the spike — the coverage
paragraphs: The Trends feed associates this search spike with 3 news stories from Boursorama, Fortuneo, Zonebourse. The headlines, exactly as published:
list: “Google investit 17 milliards de dollars dans un centre de données au Wyoming malgré les oppositions ...” — Fortuneo
“Alphabet : Google prévoit un investissement de 17 milliards de dollars dans un centre de données au Wyoming” — Zonebourse
“Google prévoit de construire un centre de données de 17 milliards de dollars dans le Wyoming, alors que les me” — Boursorama

sections.heading: Timeline
paragraphs: The trend entry was published to the Google Trends feed at Thu, 5 Nov 2026 22:40:00 -0800. Our snapshot was taken at 2026-11-06T06:54:07+00:00 UTC and this briefing was assembled at 2026-11-06T06:55:13+00:00 UTC.

sections.heading: How to read these numbers
paragraphs: Google Trends reports approximate search volume as a lower bound (for example “20K+”). Actual volume can be significantly higher. Trending status reflects acceleration in searches, not the absolute size of a topic. For the full story behind the spike, read the cited coverage below — this briefing intentionally adds no speculation beyond the sourced facts.

faq.q: How many people searched for “centre de données”?
faq.a: Google reports at least 200 searches in FR as of the feed snapshot. This is a published lower bound, not an exact count.
This snapshot covers FR. The same term may trend differently in other regions.
